svg.title: specspec: The Missing Why in Your Specification
svg.desc: The specspec logo above the headline The Missing Why in Your Specification, with Why in italics. Beside it, a small graph without text runs from a circle on the left, labeled why, through rounded cards to squares on the right, labeled how; heavier lines trace one square back through its cards to the circle. At the bottom: the GitHub mark, jejay/specspec and MIT License.
